title: Atlas runtime policy manifest v3 (forex: market pin, weekend-close exit rule, forex commission)
note: Successor of v2 (kept unchanged, sealed). Adds the market and the forex switches; FOREX runs the exit guard in ENFORCE with the single WEEKEND_CLOSE rule (30 minutes before the Friday 17:00 New York close), CRYPTO keeps OBSERVE with no rules. Read-only reference: core/policy_manifest.py compares the running application with it and any difference, or a missing/mismatching ratification, is BLOCK_NEW_RISK. Nothing is applied from this file and it can never enable live trading. Owner values 2026-10-26: commission stays 0.1 % per side until measured on the MT5 demo account; 30 minutes; weekend rule only.
owner_approval: SEE_REGISTRY: ratification is recorded in ATLAS_MILESTONE_REGISTRY_v5.106 (this field is informational and is not trusted by the check)
